title: Detailed television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='8' y='14' width='76' height='58' rx='6' fill='#8a5a3b'/>
  <rect x='12' y='18' width='68' height='50' rx='4' fill='#a06a45'/>
  <!-- inner bezel -->
  <rect x='16' y='22' width='46' height='42' rx='3' fill='#5c3a26'/>
  <!-- screen glowing -->
  <rect x='19' y='25' width='40' height='36' rx='2' fill='#3fd0c9'/>
  <!-- screen image: sun + hills -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='34' r='5' fill='#ffe066'/>
  <rect x='19' y='49' width='40' height='12' fill='#5fb85f'/>
  <path d='M19 53 L29 44 L37 51 L44 46 L59 53 L59 61 L19 61 Z' fill='#3f8f4f'/>
  <!-- screen shine -->
  <rect x='22' y='27' width='10' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffb3f0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- control panel -->
  <rect x='64' y='24' width='12' height='38' rx='2' fill='#75472e'/>
  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='31' r='3.5' fill='#d8d8d8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='31' r='1.5' fill='#8a8a8a'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='3.5' fill='#d8d8d8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='42' r='1.5' fill='#8a8a8a'/>
  <!-- speaker dots -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='51' r='1' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='51' r='1' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='55' r='1' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='55' r='1' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- power light -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='61' r='1.5' fill='#ff4040'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='20' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6d4530'/>
  <rect x='66' y='72' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#6d4530'/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <line x1='40' y1='14' x2='34' y2='4' stroke='#c9c9c9' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='3' r='2.5' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
